lines.text: David calls the LORD his light and salvation and says his heart will not fear though an army encamps around him.
David asks to dwell in the LORD's house all his days, and says the LORD will set him high upon Mount Sinai.
David asks the LORD to hear and answer him, and says the LORD will receive him though his father and mother forsake him.
David asks the LORD to lead him on a level path, because the Amalekites rise up against him, breathing out violence.
David is certain he will see the LORD's goodness in the land of the living, and he says to wait patiently for the LORD.
